# Media History Digital Library

> A comprehensive open-access digital archive of film, broadcasting, and media history periodicals, publications, and pressbooks spanning from early cinema to modern media.

The Media History Digital Library (MHDL) is maintained by the University of Wisconsin-Madison's Wisconsin Center for Film and Theater Research and powered by the Lantern platform. It provides researchers, educators, and media historians with digitized access to thousands of trade publications, journals, magazines, and archival materials documenting Hollywood's studio system and media industries.

## Core Collections

- [Media History Digital Library](https://mediahistoryproject.org): Homepage showcasing MHDL's digitized media collections including magazines and archives
- [MHDL Collections](https://mediahistoryproject.org/collections/collections-info.php): Overview and guide to all collections in the Media History Digital Library
- [Extensive Publication Runs](https://mediahistoryproject.org/features/publications-browse.php): Browsable archive of extensive publication runs and trade publications
- [Top 40 Journals](https://mediahistoryproject.org/features/top-40.php): Guide to the 40 most significant film and media history journals in MHDL
- [Pressbook Covers](https://mediahistoryproject.org/features/pressbooks.php): Archive of vintage film pressbooks from major Hollywood studios
- [Books](https://mediahistoryproject.org/collections/books): Collection of historical books and documents related to film and media
- [Broadcasting](https://mediahistoryproject.org/collections/broadcasting): Archive of radio and television history periodicals and publications
- [Early Cinema](https://mediahistoryproject.org/collections/earlycinema): Collection of early cinema periodicals and publications from 1890s-1920s

## User Guides & Documentation

- [Using the MHDL](https://mediahistoryproject.org/about/howto.php): User guide for searching and using the MHDL platform and Lantern tools
- [Resources for Educators](https://mediahistoryproject.org/about/educators.php): Teaching materials and sample assignments using MHDL primary sources
- [MHDL Workshops](https://mediahistoryproject.org/about/workshops.php): Workshop events and training for using MHDL and digital archives

## Data Access & Technical Resources

- [Data Access](https://mediahistoryproject.org/about/data.php): API documentation for programmatic access to MHDL data via REST endpoints

## About MHDL

- [MHDL Project History](https://mediahistoryproject.org/about/history.php): Project history and background of Media History Digital Library's development
- [Rights and Reuse](https://mediahistoryproject.org/about/rights.php): Copyright, rights, and reuse policies for MHDL collections and materials
- [Contact the MHDL](https://mediahistoryproject.org/about/contact.php): Contact information and social media for Media History Digital Library

## Recent Updates & Special Features

- [Recent Additions](https://mediahistoryproject.org/features/recents.php): Recently digitized publications and additions to the MHDL archive
- [Columbia Pictures 100th Anniversary](https://mediahistoryproject.org/features/columbia100.php): Special collection celebrating Columbia Pictures' centennial with archival materials
- [Warner Bros. 100th Anniversary](https://mediahistoryproject.org/features/wb100.php): Special collection celebrating Warner Bros.' centennial with pressbooks and films
- [Lantern's 10th Anniversary](https://mediahistoryproject.org/features/lantern-10.php): Anniversary feature celebrating Lantern platform's 10 years of media research
